Exchange/platform: KuCoin
Headline: KuMining Black Friday: Mine More, Get More!
Start: 2026-11-16T11:00:00Z · End: 2026-12-01T11:00:00Z
Most one person can get (parsed): 2 USDT
Smallest threshold (parsed): 40 USDT (buy)
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
KuMining Black Friday is here!
Get ready to mine more and unlock exciting rewards. From purchase bonuses and exclusive coupons to premium lucky draw prizes, there's something for every miner!
Campaign Period: From 19:00 on November 16, 2026 to 19:00 on December 1, 2026 (UTC+8)
Click "Join Now" to participate!
Campaign Details
- Purchase Rewards: Up to 72 USDT in Rewards
Reach cumulative hashrate fee milestones to unlock USDT bonuses and Hashrate Deduction Coupons:
≥100 USDT: Get 2 USDT + a 4 USDT Hashrate Deduction Coupon (Min. 80 USDT).
≥200 USDT: Get an extra 3 USDT + an 8 USDT Hashrate Deduction Coupon (Min. 160 USDT).
≥400 USDT: Get an extra 5 USDT + a 15 USDT Hashrate Deduction Coupon (Min. 300 USDT).
≥800 USDT: Get an extra 10 USDT + a 25 USDT Hashrate Deduction Coupon (Min. 500 USDT).
Mining Sprint Bonus: Extra 200 USDT：
Be among the first 3 users to reach 6,000 USDT in cumulative hashrate fees and earn an additional 200 USDT each!
- New Miner Bonus: 12 USDT in Rewards
Make your first KuMining purchase and reach 40 USDT in cumulative hashrate fees to receive:
2 USDT bonus
A 10 USDT Hashrate Deduction Coupon Pack (50-2 / 80-3 / 100-5 USDT)
- Electricity Rewards: 5 USDT Coupon
Reach an electricity top-up ratio of 80% or higher to receive a 5 USDT Electricity Deduction Coupon, covering 5% of actual daily electricity fees, up to 5 USDT in total.
- Lucky Draw: Exciting Prizes Await!
Complete daily purchase and referral tasks to earn lucky draw chances for exciting prizes, including:
iPhone Duo
1,000 USDT
Ledger Stax Hardware Wallet
End-of-Year KuCoin Gift Box
BTC, ZEC, DOGE, LTC, KAS, and more USDT rewards!
Every valid draw receives a reward. For detailed requirements and prize information, please refer to the Lucky Draw Rules on the campaign page.
Mine more, get more this Black Friday. Unlock your rewards today!
Why Choose KuMining
- Lite & Pro Modes – Easy Start, Advanced Control
- Independent Mining Account – Separate Assets and Clear Daily Tracking
- Pay Hashrate Fees First, Electricity Fees Later – A More Flexible Mining Experience
- Earn Yield on Mining Rewards and Electricity Balances – Put Your Mining Assets to Work
- Seamless Integration with the KuCoin Ecosystem – Connect Trading, Investing, and Mining in One Place
Terms and Conditions
- This campaign is open to eligible KuCoin users. All task completion and reward eligibility are subject to system records.
- Rewards, coupons, and their usage requirements are subject to the information displayed on the campaign page.
- Physical prizes will be distributed as equivalent USDT, with the final equivalent amount determined by the platform.
- Fraudulent, abusive, or abnormal activities may result in disqualification and reward cancellation or recovery.
- Cryptocurrency reward values may fluctuate due to market conditions. The actual reward amount distributed shall prevail.
- KuCoin reserves the right to modify or terminate the campaign and retains final interpretation rights.
- Apple is not a sponsor of this campaign and is not involved in the campaign in any way.
Customer Support Email: vip@kumining.com
We look forward to your participation. If you have any questions, please contact customer support.
